summary: Cubic Hermite spline interpolation over packed float data using 3DNow! SIMD. Builds the four Hermite basis functions (h00 = 2t^3 - 3t^2 + 1, h10 = t^3 - 2t^2 + t, h01 = 3t^2 - 2t^3, h11 = t^3 - t^2) from factor t loaded from parameter a6, blends four input __m64 control-point vectors (a2..a5), and writes the interpolated result into output pointer a1: full packed pair at a1[0] (offset 0x0) and a single low-lane float at a1[1] (offset 0x8). Straight-line code: no branches, no function calls; enters and exits MMX/3DNow state with femms.

local_names.t: interpolation factor, low 32-bit float lane of a6 loaded via cvtsi32_si64 (high lane zero)

operations.description: Enter MMX/3DNow state: femms clears MMX state before packed-float arithmetic.
Load interpolation factor t from parameter a6 into packed-float lanes via cvtsi32_si64: t occupies the low lane, high lane is zero.
Compute powers t^2 = t*t and t^3 = t^2*t, then h11 = t^3 - t^2.
Compute h01 = 3*t^2 - 2*t^3 using packed coefficient 3.0 from global 0x005AF998 and packed coefficient 2.0 from global 0x005AF9A0.
Compute h10 = t^3 - 2*t^2 + t using packed coefficient 2.0 from global 0x005AF9A0.
Compute h00 = 2*t^3 - 3*t^2 + 1 using packed coefficient 2.0 from global 0x005AF9A0, 3.0 from global 0x005AF998, and 1.0 from global 0x005AF988.
Splat each basis value (h11, h01, h10, h00) across both float lanes via punpckldq so both output components use identical coefficients.

Write a1[0] at offset 0x0 (full 64-bit packed pair): h00*a2[0] + h10*a3[0] + h01*a4[0] + h11*a5[0]. Low lane is interpolated component 0; the high lane collapses to a2[0]'s high float because only h00 carries a 1.0 in the high lane.

Write a1[1] low-lane float at offset 0x8: h00*a2[1].low + h10*a3[1].low + h01*a4[1].low + h11*a5[1].low, reading the low 32 bits of each control point's second __m64. High lane of a1[1] is left untouched.
Exit MMX/3DNow state: femms clears MMX state before returning.
Return the output pointer a1 (result register set to a1 at function start).
